reasons.plausibility: The proposed role of configurational entropy and local lattice strain in broadening the melting transition aligns well with established understanding of high-entropy alloys and the influence of compositional complexity on phase transitions.
reasons.testability: Direct in situ heating experiments with TEM/DSC and lattice-strain mapping provide a clear, feasible approach to confirming or refuting the predicted broadened melting and correlated strain distributions.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis targets a core question about how high configurational entropy affects nanoparticle melting, providing a clear experimental comparison and mechanistic insight relevant to designing high-temperature HEA nanoparticle applications.
